title: Acknowledgment of parentage.
partHeading: PART IV. VOLUNTARY ESTABLISHMENT OF PARENTAGE
bodyText:
PART IV. VOLUNTARY ESTABLISHMENT OF PARENTAGE

An individual who gave birth to a child and an alleged genetic parent of the child, intended parent under part VIII, or presumed parent may sign an acknowledgment of parentage to establish the parentage of the child.
bodyHtml:
PART IV.  VOLUNTARY ESTABLISHMENT OF PARENTAGE

 

     [§584A-401]  Acknowledgment of parentage.  An individual who gave birth to a child and an alleged genetic parent of the child, intended parent under part VIII, or presumed parent may sign an acknowledgment of parentage to establish the parentage of the child. [L 2025, c 298, pt of §2]
